steps.en: Configure source accounts, sitemaps, filters and approved API credentials
steps.zh: 配置来源账号、站点地图、过滤与已授权密钥

steps.en: Run the daily collector with persistent state
steps.zh: 使用持久状态运行每日采集

steps.en: Compare source snapshots and retain candidate terms
steps.zh: 比较来源快照并保存候选词

steps.en: When configured, judge names and assess keyword demand and competition
steps.zh: 配置就绪时判断名字并评估需求与竞争

steps.en: Write an evidence-linked report and retain leads for later review
steps.zh: 写出带证据报告并保留线索供复查

value.en: A repeatable shortlist of new terms rather than manually rescanning every source
value.zh: 重复获得新词候选，不必逐来源手动重查
